subject: Request: coverage endorsement for post-report period (AstraMetrics)
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@astrametrics.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@astrametrics.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:52:00 -0700
Subject: Request: coverage endorsement for post-report period (AstraMetrics)

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the SOC 2 Type II report you sent last month. As part of our procurement review we need a short coverage endorsement (often called a bridge or post-report affirmation) that confirms there have been no relevant control changes, or explains any changes, between the report end date (2027-04-30) and our contract effective date (we expect to go live 2027-07-15).

Specifically, could Redwood provide:
- A signed letter from an authorized Redwood representative addressing the period 2027-05-01 through 2027-07-15 (or current date if earlier) that either affirms continuity of controls or calls out material changes and remediation timelines.
- Any relevant updated control descriptions or evidence for changes (if applicable).
- Contact info for the audit firm in case our compliance team needs an attestation.

We'd appreciate a draft by end of day today if possible — our internal review window is tight. I can accept a Word/PDF and a DocuSign link.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Morris
Senior Procurement Manager
AstraMetrics
elena.morris@astrametrics.com
